behaviorCovered: Reported zero remains $0.00; all-unresolved zero displays unknown, not free usage.
Positive incomplete costs display a known subtotal with +; estimates use ~ and unclassified or legacy provenance uses * with explanatory text.
Overall coverage reports accounting-record counts without fabricating per-status monetary amounts or absent historical counts.
Model qualifiers come from each displayed model, never from global coverage or hidden rows.
Default shareable CLI output and the unchanged TUI stats poster omit monetary details; JSON remains an unchanged API payload.
Solid client projection retains assessment on successful and failed step settlements, including historical events without metadata.
Client reconnect, compaction, eviction and package import-boundary regressions passed.
limits: Session-family cost provenance in TUI/GUI indicators and ACP remains pending; paginated message coverage cannot classify totals that also include auxiliary calls and descendants.
Automatic detailed provider media/cache meters and validated V2 default cutover remain pending.
No graphical interface or browser changes, live inference, invoice reconciliation, remote CI, push or publication.
No changes to historical numeric cost values, public schemas, Protocol or HttpApi.
